title: Decide the style first (mood, colors, camera, pacing, and references) before…
content:
Decide the style first (mood, colors, camera, pacing, and references) before generating multi-shot videos in Seedance 2.5.  
Use Flova Agent to turn your idea into a script and storyboard, then generate the sequence in Seedance 2.5 from that plan.  
Review the Prompt Draft before generating, then generate step-by-step using the appropriate model (e.g., Seedance 2.0 vs Seedance 2.5 vs MiniMax 3.0) for each shot.  
Iterate by commenting on outputs to fix anything off-style, then save the assets or the entire workflow for reuse.  
Run the same sequence through Seedance 2.5 and other models to compare and choose the best camera control.
